english_draft:
Title: Historical Reconstruction: Amazon (AMZN) Q4 2025 Preview.

Note: This preview is a retrospective reconstruction. It uses only information published before 2025-10-30 23:59:59. It is not a contemporaneous forecast.

Conclusion:
1. Amazon reported Q3 2025 net sales of 180.2 billion USD. This was an increase of 13% year over year.
2. AWS segment sales were 33.0 billion USD. This was an increase of 20% year over year.
3. Operating income was 17.4 billion USD. It was flat year over year.
4. Two special charges reduced operating income: a 2.5 billion USD legal settlement with the FTC and 1.8 billion USD of severance costs.
5. Without these charges, operating income would have been 21.7 billion USD.
6. For Q4 2025, the company guided net sales of 206.0 to 213.0 billion USD. This implies growth of 10% to 13% year over year.
7. The company guided Q4 operating income of 21.0 to 26.0 billion USD. Q4 2024 operating income was 21.2 billion USD.
8. The company expects a favorable foreign exchange impact of about 190 basis points on Q4 net sales growth.

Prior quarter baseline:
9. North America segment sales were 106.3 billion USD, up 11%.
10. International segment sales were 40.9 billion USD, up 14%. Excluding foreign exchange, growth was 10%.
11. North America operating income was 4.8 billion USD. Without the FTC charge, it would have been 7.3 billion USD.
12. International operating income was 1.2 billion USD. It was 1.3 billion USD in the prior year.
13. AWS operating income was 11.4 billion USD. It was 10.4 billion USD in the prior year.
14. Net income was 21.2 billion USD, or 1.95 USD per diluted share. It included 9.5 billion USD of pre-tax gains from Anthropic investments.
15. Trailing twelve-month operating cash flow was 130.7 billion USD, up 16%.
16. Trailing twelve-month free cash flow was 14.8 billion USD. It was 47.7 billion USD in the prior year. The main driver was a 50.9 billion USD increase in property and equipment purchases.

Core questions:
17. Can AWS maintain about 20% growth? AWS re-accelerated to 20.2% growth. The company added 3.8 gigawatts of capacity. Trainium2 is fully subscribed.
18. Where will Q4 operating income land in the 21.0 to 26.0 billion USD range? The midpoint is 23.5 billion USD.
19. Will rising capital expenditures keep reducing free cash flow? TTM free cash flow already fell sharply. Q4 holiday spending and AI capacity may continue this trend.

Positive divergences:
20. AWS growth is the fastest since 2022.
21. Trainium2 grew 150% quarter over quarter. Project Rainier contains nearly 500,000 Trainium2 chips.
22. Foreign exchange adds about 190 basis points to Q4 growth.
23. The company plans 250,000 US seasonal jobs. It plans same-day perishable grocery delivery to more than 2,300 communities.

Negative divergences:
24. Q3 operating income was flat because of special charges.
25. The Q4 guidance assumes no new acquisitions, restructurings, or legal settlements. Q3 showed that special charges can appear.
26. International operating income declined year over year.
27. TTM free cash flow decreased from 47.7 billion USD to 14.8 billion USD.

Verification points:
28. Check net sales against the 206.0 to 213.0 billion USD range.
29. Check AWS growth against 20%.
30. Check operating income against the 21.0 to 26.0 billion USD range and the 23.5 billion USD midpoint.
31. Check TTM capital expenditures and free cash flow.
32. Check for new special charges and non-operating investment gains.
33. Check the Q1 2026 guidance.

Analysis:
34. There is no contemporaneous preview in the attached sources. The review result is 'no contemporaneous preview'.
35. Actual Q4 results are outside the data cutoff. This reconstruction does not add them.
36. After the actual Q4 report, compare results with the guidance ranges. Focus on AWS growth, capital expenditures, and free cash flow.
reader_questions: Q4 经营利润指引假定不再发生并购、重组或法律和解，而 Q3 已出现 FTC 和解与裁员准备金两笔专项费用——若 Q4 再现类似一次性项，经营利润是否会跌破指引下沿（210 亿美元），该指引还有多大参考意义？
AWS 分部经营利润率约 34.5% 是含裁员准备金且未剔除专项费用的数字：新增 3.8GW 电力投运后的折旧与电力成本、AI 推理等低毛利业务占比上升，会否使 Q4 AWS 分部利润率明显下行？
Q3 净利（212 亿美元）包含 Anthropic 非经营投资税前收益 95 亿美元；若 Q4 无类似项目，净利与每股收益的同比口径会否因基期项目而失真，市场是否应更关注经营利润而非净利同比？
fact_checks:
第一轮核实（原始来源核对）：
- 来源：仅 Amazon IR 官网 2025Q3 季报（2025-10-30 发布），未使用任何财报后资料。原始正文个别句子被资料库截断（如 operational income 后段），但关键财务数字、分部经营利润与 Q4 指引均完整可核对。
- 2025Q3 分部收入：净销售额 $180.2B（+13%、剔汇 +12%）；北美 $106.3B（+11%）；国际 $40.9B（+14%、剔汇 +10%）；AWS $33.0B（+20%）——与原文一致。
- 2025Q3 利润：经营利润 $17.4B（同比持平）；FTC 和解 $2.5B、裁员准备金 $1.8B，剔除后 $21.7B；北美经营利润 $4.8B（剔 FTC 后 $7.3B）；国际 $1.2B；AWS 经营利润 $11.4B——与原文一致。
- 2025Q3 净利及现金流：净利 $21.2B（Diluted EPS $1.95），含 Anthropic 投资税前收益 $9.5B；TTM 经营现金流 $130.7B（+16%）；TTM 自由现金流 $14.8B（上年 $47.7B），资本开支同比 +$50.9B——与原文一致。
- 2025Q4 指引：净销售额 $206.0–$213.0B（+10%–13%，汇率 +190bps）；经营利润 $21.0–$26.0B（2024Q4 $21.2B），假定无新增并购/重组/法律和解——与原文一致。
- 业务亮点：AWS +20.2%（CEO 引语）、3.8GW/12 个月、Trainium2 满产且 +150% QoQ、Project Rainier 近 500,000 颗芯片、年底 2,300+ 同日达生鲜社区、250,000 美国季节性岗位、Connect 年化运行率 $1B——均按公司披露口径引用，未视为财报口径收入/利润。
- 币种与口径：全部为美元；财政季度为 2025Q4（截至 2025-12-31，按公司报告口径）；GAAP 为基础，专项费用剔除属于公司说明性口径。
- 本稿推算项（非原文明示）：AWS 分部经营利润率 34.5%（$11.4B/$33.0B）；指引中值 $23.5B 且同比约 +11%；TTM FCF 降幅约 69%；Q4 剔汇增速约 +8%–11%。正文均已标注“本稿推算”。
第二轮互检后正文修订：在财报验证点中新增“是否再现专项费用”“AWS 分部利润率”“净利中非经营投资收益”三项，以回应读者三问。
同期 Preview 核查：所附来源中只有 Q3 季报原文，不含任何财报前 Preview，复核结论为「无同期 Preview」。
